mapper.select: SELECT f.annual_income AS annualIncome, e.employment_code AS employmentTypeCode, f.credit_score_band AS creditScoreBand, f.main_bank AS mainBank, f.existing_loan_amount AS existingLoanAmount FROM customer_finances f LEFT JOIN employment_types e ON e.employment_type_id = f.employment_type_id WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_finances SET annual_income = #{row.annualIncome}, employment_type_id = (SELECT employment_type_id FROM employment_types WHERE employment_code = #{row.employmentTypeCode}), credit_score_band = #{row.creditScoreBand}, main_bank = #{row.mainBank}, existing_loan_amount = #{row.existingLoanAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_finances (member_id, annual_income, employment_type_id, credit_score_band, main_bank, existing_loan_amount) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{row.annualIncome}, (SELECT employment_type_id FROM employment_types WHERE employment_code = #{row.employmentTypeCode}), #{row.creditScoreBand}, #{row.mainBank}, #{row.existingLoanAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT employment_code FROM employment_types ORDER BY employment_type_id
